description: Phasor generator: a 0-10V ramp repeating over and over, free-running or locked to a clock, with pulses, jitter and an end-of-cycle trigger

params.text: Sets how fast the ramp cycles; with a clock patched it becomes a multiply or divide of that clock instead
Attenuverts the frequency CV input, -1 to +1
Shifts the output forward or back within its cycle; the knob's range covers one whole cycle either way
Attenuverts the phase CV input, -1 to +1
Sets the width of the gates at the Pulses output, from 0% to 100% of a pulse, with 50% at centre
Attenuverts the pulse width CV input, -1 to +1
Sets how many pulses the Pulses output fires per cycle of the ramp, 1 to 64 in whole numbers
Attenuverts the pulses per cycle CV input, -1 to +1; 5V at full depth covers the whole 1 to 64 range
Sets how far a random value pushes the cycle rate about, 0 to 5; a fresh value is drawn at the end of every cycle
Attenuverts the jitter CV input, -1 to +1
Slow gives an LFO range; Fast lifts the whole frequency range into the audio band

inputs.text: Modulates the cycle rate, scaled by its attenuverter
Modulates the number of pulses per cycle
Adds to the cycle rate at a volt per octave, with no attenuverter on it
Patching a clock here locks the ramp to it, and the Frequency knob becomes a multiply or divide of that clock
A rising edge restarts the ramp at the beginning of its cycle
Holds the ramp at its current value for as long as this is at 1V or above

outputs.text: The ramp itself, rising from 0V to 10V over each cycle
A 10V gate for each pulse in the cycle, at the width set by Pulse Width
The random value currently pushing the frequency about, -5V to 5V, redrawn at the end of each cycle
A 10V trigger on the sample where the ramp completes a cycle
